VCST-5733 AUTHORSHIP matrix, cell "served org x REP-authored". customerId IS SR_REP_PRIMARY's own ApplicationUser id, so the rep is this order's customer: it must appear in BOTH salesRepOrders ("orders I placed", which sets criteria.CustomerId) and salesRepCustomerOrders (org-scoped, no CustomerId), and open on the buyer page /account/orders/:id with the Pay-now / Reorder affordances live. It is the CONTROL for both arms of the matrix: SRO-TF-BUYER-PLACED varies only the customer, SRO-EU-NOT-SERVED varies only the organization. store/status/items_count are held identical across all three ON PURPOSE (sales-rep-orders-specs.mjs AUTHORSHIP_CONTROLLED_COLUMNS) so a behavioural difference has exactly one candidate explanation; total 118.00 is distinct so a case can say which order it read. Guarded by td:validate:sr-orders check [5].

VCST-5733 AUTHORSHIP matrix, cell "served org x BUYER-authored". customerId is the ApplicationUser id of USR-007 (the seeded TechFlow buyer), resolved live by email at seed time - NEVER a committed GUID. SAME org, store, status and item count as SRO-TF-REP-PLACED, so the ONLY difference is who the customer is; that is what makes "opens read-only in the hub, Print only" attributable to AUTHORSHIP rather than to org scope or to status. Must appear in salesRepCustomerOrders and must NOT appear in salesRepOrders (which pins criteria.CustomerId to the caller). Without this row the two queries are indistinguishable on fixture data. Guarded by td:validate:sr-orders check [5].

VCST-5733 AUTHORSHIP matrix, cell "UNSERVED org x REP-authored". ORG-005 (Acme-EU-Operations) is Active and SR_REP_PRIMARY holds NO membership on it (verified live 2026-09-02: zero memberships, salesRepCustomerOrders(organizationId:ORG-005) totalCount 0). salesRepCustomerOrder(id:) must return null - PR #14 loads the order then filters on served OrganizationId, so the negative answer is null, NOT an error - and the list must never contain it. REP-AUTHORED ON PURPOSE and this is load-bearing: the rep is this order's own customer, so the only thing separating it from SRO-TF-REP-PLACED (which IS returned) is the organization, which is what makes a null attributable to ORG SCOPE. A buyer-authored version would be explainable by either dimension. ORG-006/ORG_SUSPENDED is DISQUALIFIED as the host because its status is Suspended, giving the exclusion a second candidate cause. Guarded by td:validate:sr-orders check [5].
